property_address_full: 7555 Palmetto Commerce Pkwy (Tract G-1) and adjacent Tract G-2, North Charleston, Charleston County, SC 29420
vesting_paragraph: Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, a South Carolina limited liability company, as surviving entity of the merger of Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, 3074 Ashley Phosphate Properties, LLC, Ashley/Spartan Properties, LLC, Ashley Phosphate Properties, LLC, and Spartan Lands, LLC, effective at the close of business June 30, 2014, evidenced by Articles of Merger recorded July 3, 2014 in Book 0414 at Page 993, Office of the Register of Deeds for Charleston County, South Carolina.
prior_chain_paragraph: Title to Tract G-1 was acquired by Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC by deed of Ashley Industrial Developers, II, A Limited Partnership, dated January 28, 2000, recorded January 31, 2000 in Book P341 at Page 577. Title to Tract G-2 was acquired by Spartan Lands, LLC (predecessor by merger to Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC) by deed of Ashley Industrial Developers, II, A Limited Partnership, dated January 28, 2000, recorded January 31, 2000 in Book P341 at Page 571. Both deeds derive from a portion of the property conveyed to Ashley Industrial Developers, II, A Limited Partnership by deed of Grant Associates, A General Partnership, dated December 20, 1988, recorded in Book L180 at Page 719.
legal_description_paragraphs: All that certain piece, parcel or tract of land, situate, lying and being in the City of North Charleston, County of Charleston, State of South Carolina, containing 13.279 acres, more or less, and being shown and designated as TRACT G-1 on a plat entitled "Boundary Survey of Tract G-1 Located at 7555 N. Spartan Blvd., Owned by Ashley Industrial Developers II, LP, About to be Conveyed to Spartan Boulevard Properties, L.L.C.," prepared by Mark A. Cornelius, P.L.S. #18263, of General Engineering Laboratories, Inc., dated December 10, 1999, recorded January 31, 2000 in Plat Book ED at Page 760, Office of the Register of Deeds for Charleston County, SC. Said tract being more particularly described according to said plat as having such metes, bounds, courses and distances as will by reference thereto more fully appear.
TOGETHER WITH all rights, privileges, appurtenances, and improvements thereunto belonging, including the warehouse and office building located thereon.

All that certain piece, parcel or tract of land, situate, lying and being in the City of North Charleston, County of Charleston, State of South Carolina, containing 13.608 acres, more or less, and being shown and designated as TRACT G-2 on a plat entitled "Boundary Survey of Tract G-2 (13.608 Acres) Owned by Ashley Industrial Developers II, LP, About to be Conveyed to Spartan Lands, L.L.C.," prepared by Mark A. Cornelius, P.L.S. #18263, of General Engineering Laboratories, Inc., dated December 10, 1999, recorded January 31, 2000 in Plat Book ED at Page 761, Office of the Register of Deeds for Charleston County, SC. Said tract being more particularly described according to said plat as having such metes, bounds, courses and distances as will by reference thereto more fully appear.

DERIVATION: The two Tracts together being a portion of "Tract A" (32.07 acres) shown on plat by Davis & Floyd, Inc., dated June 28, 1985, recorded in Plat Book BF at Page 9, and further shown as the parent tract subdivided into Tracts G-1 and G-2 on plat recorded in Plat Book BU at Page 77 (1988).
requirements: Pay the agreed amounts for the interest in the Land and/or the mortgage to be insured.
Pay all premiums, fees, and charges for the Policy.
Documents satisfactory to the Company that convey the Title or create the Mortgage to be insured, or both, must be properly authorized, executed, delivered, and recorded in the Public Records.

Furnish a properly executed and acknowledged Owner's Affidavit and Indemnity (in the form required by the Company) from Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, addressing parties in possession, mechanics' liens, unrecorded easements, gap items, and similar matters.

Furnish current Articles of Organization, Operating Agreement (and all amendments), and a Certificate of Existence/Good Standing from the South Carolina Secretary of State for Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, together with appropriate authorizing resolutions/consents authorizing the conveyance.

Confirmatory Conveyance / Affidavit of Merger: Charleston County tax records (TMS 484-00-00-019) currently identify Spartan Lands, LLC as the assessed owner of Tract G-2 notwithstanding its merger out of existence into Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC at the close of business June 30, 2014 (Bk 0414/Pg 993). Furnish, and record in the Charleston County Register of Deeds, a Confirmatory Deed (or, at the Company's option, an Affidavit of Merger / Notice of Vesting) in form satisfactory to the Company evidencing the post-merger vesting of Tract G-2 in Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, and provide evidence of corresponding update to the Charleston County Auditor/Assessor's records.

Mortgage payoff/release — Bk 0567/Pg 007: Procure and record a Satisfaction (or, if the loan is being modified or extended, a Modification Agreement and any partial release(s)) of that certain Mortgage from Atlantic Properties of Charleston Limited Partnership, Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, and 904 Commerce Circle LLC to CresCom Bank (now United Bank), in the original principal amount of $22,000,000.00 (maximum obligation $26,000,000.00), dated July 8, 2016, recorded in Book 0567 at Page 007, together with the Assignment of Leases, Rents and Profits recorded in Book 0567 at Page 009 of even date.

UCC release(s) — Filing No. 2016-10876 and continuations/amendments: Procure and file a UCC Termination Statement releasing UCC-1 Financing Statement (Fixture Filing) No. 2016-10876, recorded July 8, 2016, by CresCom Bank (now United Bank) against Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, as continued by UCC No. 2021-01334 (recorded July 30, 2021) and as amended/continued by UCC No. 2026-00421 (recorded March 4, 2026, instrument 2026013467); or otherwise obtain a partial release of fixtures as to Tract G-1.

Mortgage payoff/release — Bk 0994/Pg 296: Procure and record a Satisfaction of that certain Commercial Real Estate Mortgage with future-advance and cross-collateralization clauses from Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC (Mortgagor) for the benefit of Corporate Road Properties, LLC (Borrower) to United Bank, in the principal amount of $4,400,000.00, dated and recorded May 24, 2021 in Book 0994 at Page 296. Because this is a cross-collateralization mortgage securing all present and future obligations of Mortgagor to United Bank, the Company will require United Bank's written confirmation of all obligations secured.

Pay all real estate taxes and assessments for tax year 2026 (and any prior years) when due, and provide evidence to the Company that all taxes and assessments through the date of policy are paid in full. Tax years 2022 through 2025 are paid of record on both TMS 484-00-00-119 and TMS 484-00-00-019.

Furnish a current ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey of Tracts G-1 and G-2 prepared by a South Carolina-registered land surveyor, certified to the Company and the Proposed Insured(s), showing all matters of record set forth in Schedule B, Part II, the location of all improvements, encroachments, parking, and means of access, and showing compliance with applicable boundary, building setback, and access requirements; alternatively, the General Survey Exception will not be deleted from the Policy.

Re-run state tax/lien searches with the South Carolina Department of Employment and Workforce (DEW) and the South Carolina Department of Revenue (DOR) State Tax Lien Registry against the following names and confirm no active liens prior to closing: Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC; Spartan Lands, LLC; 3074 Ashley Phosphate Properties, LLC; Ashley/Spartan Properties, LLC; Ashley Phosphate Properties, LLC; Atlantic Properties of Charleston Limited Partnership; 904 Commerce Circle LLC; Corporate Road Properties, LLC; Ashley Industrial Developers, II, A Limited Partnership; Grant Associates; David Maybank, Jr.; David Maybank III; John F. Maybank II; and Peter Maybank.
Final search of the Public Records (gap update) immediately prior to recording, with Company-approved indemnification for the gap period.
exceptions: Defects, liens, encumbrances, adverse claims, or other matters, if any, created, first appearing in the Public Records, or attaching subsequent to the effective date hereof but prior to the date the Proposed Insured acquires of record for value the estate or interest or Mortgage thereon covered by this Commitment.
Rights or claims of parties in possession not shown by the Public Records.
Encroachments, overlaps, boundary line disputes, and any other matters that would be disclosed by an accurate and complete survey and inspection of the Land.
Easements, liens or encumbrances, or claims thereof, not shown by the Public Records.
Any lien, or right to a lien, for services, labor, or material heretofore or hereafter furnished, imposed by law and not shown by the Public Records.

Taxes or special assessments not shown as existing liens by the Public Records or, if shown, not yet due and payable, including but not limited to ad valorem real property taxes for the year 2026 and subsequent years, a lien but not yet due and payable.

Any inaccuracies, deficiencies, or discrepancies in the Public Records concerning the post-merger vesting of TMS 484-00-00-019 (Tract G-2) in Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, until the Confirmatory Conveyance/Affidavit of Merger required under Schedule B, Part I has been recorded.

That certain Mortgage from Atlantic Properties of Charleston Limited Partnership, Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, and 904 Commerce Circle LLC to CresCom Bank (now United Bank), in the original principal amount of $22,000,000.00 (maximum obligation $26,000,000.00), dated July 8, 2016, recorded July 8, 2016 in Book 0567 at Page 007, with stated maturity of July 8, 2026, and any modifications, extensions, or amendments thereof. (Burdens Tract G-1 only.)

That certain Assignment of Leases, Rents and Profits from Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC to CresCom Bank (now United Bank), dated July 8, 2016, recorded July 8, 2016 in Book 0567 at Page 009, securing the indebtedness described in Exception 8. (Burdens Tract G-1 only.)

UCC-1 Financing Statement (Fixture Filing) No. 2016-10876, filed July 8, 2016 by CresCom Bank (now United Bank) against Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, as continued by UCC Continuation No. 2021-01334 filed July 30, 2021, and as amended/continued by UCC No. 2026-00421 filed March 4, 2026 (Instrument 2026013467), and any additional continuations or amendments thereof. (Burdens Tract G-1 only.)

That certain Commercial Real Estate Mortgage (with future advance and cross-collateralization clauses) from Spartan Boulevard Properties, LLC, as Mortgagor, securing the obligations of Corporate Road Properties, LLC, as Borrower, to United Bank, in the principal amount of $4,400,000.00, dated and recorded May 24, 2021 in Book 0994 at Page 296, and any modifications, extensions, or amendments thereof. (Burdens Tract G-1 only.)

Right of Way Grant for utility purposes (electric power, communications, gas, oil, and petroleum lines and appurtenances) from Ashley Industrial Developers, II, A Limited Partnership, to South Carolina Electric & Gas Company, dated May 1, 1989, recorded June 2, 1989 in Book W184 at Page 551, and as further depicted on Plat Book ED at Page 760 (showing 20-foot SCE&G power easement on Tract G-1 referenced as Bk W184/Pg 553). (Burdens Tracts G-1 and G-2.)

Grant of Perpetual Easement (15-foot Sanitary Sewer Easement) from Grant Associates, A General Partnership, to North Charleston Sewer District, dated July 13, 1988, recorded August 2, 1988 in Book X176 at Page 287, lying along the southwesterly side of the 200-foot Southern Railroad right-of-way. (Burdens Tracts G-1 and G-2.)

Grant of Easement (15-foot Sanitary Sewer Easement, with 20-foot temporary construction easement (expired)) from Grant Associates, A General Partnership, to North Charleston Sewer District, dated January 20, 1986, recorded March 16, 1988 in Book E173 at Page 771. (Burdens Tracts G-1 and G-2.)

All matters shown on or referenced by that certain plat entitled "Plat Showing Sub-Division of TMS 484-00-00-019 into Tracts G-1 & G-2, Property of Ashley Industrial Developers II, A Partnership," prepared by Albert Heatley, Jr., S.C.R.L.S. #3973-B, of Davis & Floyd, Inc., dated November 2, 1988, recorded January 19, 1989 in Plat Book BU at Page 77, including without limitation: dedication of Road "A" (now N. Spartan Boulevard) (90-foot right-of-way, 4.972 acres) and associated drainage and sanitary sewer easements; the 30-foot drainage easement, 20-foot drainage easement, and 15-foot sanitary sewer easement depicted thereon; and any negative-access provisions or restrictions therein.

All matters shown on or referenced by Plat Book ED at Page 760 (Boundary Survey of Tract G-1, dated December 10, 1999) and Plat Book ED at Page 761 (Boundary Survey of Tract G-2, dated December 10, 1999), each prepared by Mark A. Cornelius, P.L.S. #18263, of General Engineering Laboratories, Inc.

Riparian and littoral rights, freshwater wetlands, stormwater detention obligations, and all matters relating to wetlands or jurisdictional waters within Tract G-2 (containing approximately 1.402 acres of freshwater wetlands and 1.383 acres of stormwater detention as shown on Plat Book ED at Page 761) and any stormwater detention obligations within Tract G-1 (containing approximately 0.043 acres of stormwater detention as shown on Plat Book ED at Page 760).

Rights of the United States of America, the State of South Carolina, the County of Charleston, the City of North Charleston, the public, or any abutting owners in and to any portion of the Land lying within the bounds of any public road, street, alley, easement, or right-of-way, including without limitation N. Spartan Boulevard / Palmetto Commerce Parkway and Ashley Phosphate Road; and rights of the Southern Railway Company / Norfolk Southern Railway Company in and to its 200-foot right-of-way adjoining the easterly boundary of the Land.

Terms, conditions, restrictions, easements, and other provisions, if any, set forth in the deed to Ashley Industrial Developers, II, Limited Partnership recorded in Book L180 at Page 719 and in the Master's Deed to Grant Associates recorded in Book H146 at Page 543, including any references therein to the prior chains of title rooted in (i) deed from J.S. Hyer to Cesar Green dated 1893, recorded in Berkeley County Deed Book A10 at Page 285, and (ii) deed from J.S. Hyer to Sanco (a/k/a Zango) Grant dated 1892, recorded in Berkeley County Deed Book A9 at Page 255.

Zoning, building, environmental, and land use ordinances and regulations of the City of North Charleston and the County of Charleston, including without limitation requirements relating to subdivision, access, parking, signage, and fixture filings; and any consequences of any violation thereof now or hereafter existing.

Subject to the standard exclusions from coverage set forth in the 2021 ALTA Owner's Policy/Loan Policy, including, without limitation, governmental regulations, eminent domain, defects created/suffered by the Insured, matters not in the Public Records, and matters first appearing after the Date of Policy.
